library.title: al-Sira al-Nabawiyya — Ibn Hisham
library.compiler: Ibn Hisham (d. 218; 213 in some sources), from Ibn Ishaq (d. 151)
library.description: Compiled by Ibn Hisham (d. 218; 213 in some sources), from Ibn Ishaq (d. 151). The life of the Prophet ﷺ as Ibn Ishaq told it and Ibn Hisham edited it: his lineage, birth, the revelation, Mecca, the Hijra, the campaigns and his death — 264 chapters, 2,109 sections, each report with its chain as the author gives it.
